requirement.normalizedRequirement: The web thickness of the frames shall be at least the maximum of: h_w*sqrt(sigma_y)/C, where C = 805 for profiles and C = 282 for flat bars; half of the net shell-plating thickness t - t_c; and 9 mm. Where a deck, tank top, tank bottom or bulkhead is used in lieu of a frame, its plate thickness shall be calculated in the same way using the adjacent frame height h_w and C = 805.
requirement.section: Support of frames against instability, in particular tripping
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
